<h2>Prepare Scientific Fold Content for Calibration Hashing</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Excludes operational runtime and memory measurements from signatures.
Fold assignments, observations, predictors and spatial strategy provenance
remain unchanged. This does not alter the folds used for fitting.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>prepare_sjsdm_cv_calibration_hash_folds(
  list_prepared_folds,
  contract_version = base::c("v5", "v4")
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="list_prepared_folds">list_prepared_folds</code></td>
<td>
<p>Cached records returned by [prepare_sjsdm_tuning_folds()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="contract_version">contract_version</code></td>
<td>
<p>Signature version. Version four retains memory fields for exact migration
proof; the default version five excludes operational memory fields too.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A copy of the fold records without operational runtime fields.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>prepare_sjsdm_cv_calibration_hash_folds(list())
</code></pre>
